Thank you for suggesting an improvement.

## Use case

What would you like to do, and who would benefit?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the behavior or API you would like to see.

## Interface impact

Does this require a change to a public SDK contract, or could it be implemented behind an
existing interface? If you tried an existing extension point, describe the gap. It is fine to
leave this section blank if you are not sure.

## Hardware requirements

Note any device or firmware version needed to validate the proposal.

## Scope

This gateway implements the protocol for AtomS3R stack-chan firmware. Ideas that require a
different wire protocol are usually best discussed in the
[firmware repository](https://github.com/kkdev92/stackchan-atoms3r). If you are unsure where an
idea belongs, open the issue here and a maintainer can help identify the appropriate project.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative approaches or workarounds you considered.

## Additional context
